newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTT Exploration unit finds more natgas.
newsitem.headline: PTT Exploration unit finds more natgas.

text.p: Thailand's PTT Exploration and Production Plc said on Tuesday its joint venture unit had discovered additional natural gas in the Muda Gas Field in the southern Thailand-Malaysia Joint Development Area.

The unit, Carigali - PTTEPI Operating Company Sendirian Berhad (CPOC), had hit natural gas flow estimated at 22 million cubic feet per day and condensates of 259 barrels per day in the Muda-3 well, PTT Exploration said in a statement.
CPOC is a joint venture between Petronas Carigali (JDA) Sdn Bhd, a subsidiary of Malaysia's Petronas, and PTTEP International Co Ltd, PTT Exploration's international arm.
The JDA covers an area of 7,250 square kilometres in the Gulf of Thailand.
CPOC had earlier discovered natural gas in the Muda-1 well, four kilometre west of Muda-3, in 1995, the statement said.
